candidate.required_runtime: Lean 4.35.0; a 4.32.1-only build cannot audit the selected foundation's 4.35.0 oleans

corpus.module_selection: Enumerate all source modules of the four library roots and require corresponding compiled artifacts; never infer full coverage from the first library or root import alone.
corpus.required_public_theorems: Every entry of proofs/foundation/inventory.json theorems, selected independently of the candidate output
corpus.private_helpers: Every inventory.private_theorems entry must be accounted for as a source declaration; compare the candidate's compiled private declarations with independent Lean collection, and disclose any mapping gap.
corpus.policy: Compare exact per-required-root transitive axioms with the selected Lean audit, not only the global propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound allowlist. Preserve stricter empty-axiom profiles. Compare the project-wide union and every policy violation.

negative_controls: private helper relying on an imported custom axiom
custom axiom from an imported module outside the audited root
sorryAx introduced by an isolated throwaway fixture
Lean.ofReduceBool introduced by an isolated native-evaluation fixture
mutual-inductive or cyclic dependency cluster with per-declaration stock-audit comparison
go_rule: GO only if the pinned upstream source builds under the selected Lean 4.35.0; all four library/module rosters are complete; every required-root axiom set, project union and policy violation agrees with the independent inventory-bound Lean audit; every private helper is accounted for or its incompleteness is an explicit NO-GO; every negative control is correctly detected; no audit result replaces proof-term checking, independent replay, statement or protected-definition binding; wall time and peak RSS are retained.
no_go_rule: NO-GO on build/import incompatibility, incomplete module/root/private coverage, any per-root axiom mismatch or missed control, unavailable source/artifacts, or inability to measure either side on identical selected compiled inputs. Retain the existing audit as decisive and record an exact blocker with a reopen condition.
non_claims: This tool imports compiled environments at trust level 1024 and does not validate proof terms.
No audit-only result proves source authenticity or executable correctness.
